cases.title: Rogue payment command without a shopkeeper
cases.mission: Ordinary Rogue explores to locate a shop, inspect stock, pick up and return or retain an affordable item, pay, leave, revisit, and inspect billing state.
cases.selectionRationale: Tests the shop payment and billing family from an ordinary Rogue action history, with room and corridor traversal, a monster fight, pet activity, and gold pickup. The generated first-level route was chosen from the C source mission before C play.
cases.cOutcome: The ordinary Rogue left the starting room, crossed a corridor and doorway, fought a kobold, observed pet activity, picked up 7 gold pieces, and invoked #pay. C reported that no shopkeeper was present. No shop was found, so purchase, billing, leaving, and revisiting were not reached. This complete valid no-shop result is retained.
cases.reproducibility: Independent C replay command: node scripts/record-session.mjs challenges/cases/v2/shop-ledger-return.recipe.json .cache/c-exploration/shop-ledger-return-independent.session.json; exit code 0. The independent C recording exactly matched the exploratory recording, including the complete screens, cursor positions, and RNG traces (56 boundaries). Log: /tmp/teleport-loop-worker-c-20260925/.cache/c-exploration/shop-ledger-return-independent.log.

cases.title: Neutral altar prayer and corpse offering
cases.mission: A debug-setup neutral Priest creates a neutral altar and fresh jackal corpse, then invokes prayer without forcing success and offers the corpse.
cases.selectionRationale: Varies role and state through a debug-created neutral altar and fresh corpse, then exercises prayer confirmation and the sacrifice/altar result path.
cases.cOutcome: The debug Priest wished a neutral altar and jackal corpse at the current tile, invoked #pray, declined the force-success confirmation, then selected the corpse for #offer. C consumed it in a plume of smoke and reported a hopeful feeling. No prayer success was forced.

cases.title: Wizard starting spells, book reading, and casting
cases.mission: An ordinary Wizard inspects known spells, reads the guaranteed starting Force Bolt book, casts at a reachable hostile, then inspects remembered spell state.
cases.selectionRationale: Exercises Wizard startup spell state, an already-known spellbook read, the Z casting command, and an independent spell-list inspection in a different ordinary action history.
sourcePointers: nethack-c/upstream/src/u_init.c: Wizard starting inventory and ini_inv_use_obj()
cases.cOutcome: C showed blessed Force Bolt and uncursed Sleep books, with both spells already known at 100% retention. Reading Force Bolt reported it was already well known. A lowercase-z/spacing attempt led to an eastward movement turn; the proper uppercase-Z command then cast Force Bolt east into a wall, reducing Pw from 6 to 1. #showspells showed both spells at 91%-100% retention. No hostile was reached or targeted.
